title: First-Order Data in a Form of Its Own
question: Can closed, first-order values stop paying for open terms, with a value form of their own that is especially efficient to serialize? Matthew, 2026-11-08, ^ticket(718).
measurements: Experiments 1 to 5 on the Witch slide's picture, Hazel's side in Firefox on GitHub's machines on the livelits line (trial/694-view-jit, DataExperiment.re: commits a64335dc37 to 238144b4b8), Fumola's on the laptop (native for experiment 1, its wasm build in Node for experiment 5). Experiment 2 is a first slice: nodes built outside a run, read as a ceiling. Nothing is measured on dev yet; the 15 KB for the Witch's points is arithmetic.
